familyHints.acoustic: How the voice sounds: energy, pitch and breathiness
familyHints.tempo: The pace of speech, pauses and how fast the agent answers
familyHints.lexical: Negative words, indifference and short, scripted replies
familyHints.cognitive: Signs of mental fog: asking to repeat, losing the thread
familyHints.context: Days in a row with negative sentiment or emotion in the agent

pitchVariability.label: Pitch variability
pitchVariability.description: How much the voice rises and falls. A flat, monotone voice is a sign of exhaustion.

vocalEnergy.label: Vocal energy
vocalEnergy.description: Loudness and drive of the voice. It drops when the agent is drained.

breathiness.label: Breathy voice
breathiness.description: Share of speech that sounds breathy or faint.

sighs.label: Audible sighs
sighs.description: Sighs and heavy breaths per minute of speech.

speechRate.label: Speech rate
speechRate.description: Words per minute. It slows down with fatigue.

longPauses.label: Long pauses
longPauses.description: Silences from the agent of more than 3 seconds, per call.

responseLatency.label: Response delay
responseLatency.description: Seconds between the customer finishing and the agent answering.

negativeLanguage.label: Negative language
negativeLanguage.description: Negative words and expressions per 100 words the agent says.

apathyPhrases.label: Apathy phrases
apathyPhrases.description: Phrases of giving up or indifference, such as "whatever you say" or "nothing I can do".

shortTurns.label: Short, scripted replies
shortTurns.description: Share of the agent's turns with four words or fewer.

empathyPhrases.label: Empathy phrases
empathyPhrases.description: Phrases that acknowledge the customer. Fewer of them is the warning.

repeatRequests.label: Asks to repeat
repeatRequests.description: Times the agent asks the customer to say something again.

selfCorrections.label: Self-corrections
selfCorrections.description: Times the agent restarts or corrects their own sentence.

lostThread.label: Loses the thread
lostThread.description: Times the agent asks something the customer already answered.

lowSentimentDays.label: Days in a row with low sentiment
lowSentimentDays.description: Consecutive working days on which the agent's average sentiment stays below the limit.

negativeEmotionDays.label: Days in a row with negative emotion
negativeEmotionDays.description: Consecutive working days with many calls where the agent's predominant emotion is negative.

ui.none: No voice signal is active right now.
ui.changeHint: Change against the agent's own usual level, in the worse direction
ui.streakHint: Days in a row needed for the signal to count as active

streakRule.lowSentimentDays: Average sentiment below {{limit}} · hostile-customer days left out
streakRule.negativeEmotionDays: More than {{limit}}% of calls with negative emotion · hostile-customer days left out
